title: Vendedor De Sorvetes (Diversas Regiões Do Brasil)
description:
A vida fica melhor com sorvete

Com 19.000 especialistas em sorvetes e marcas icônicas como Kibon, Cornetto e Ben & Jerry’s, amadas em 76 países, somos a maior empresa de sorvetes do mundo e líder do setor. Levamos o prazer a sério há mais de 100 anos, proporcionando felicidade a cada lambida ou bola de sorvete e criando momentos especiais para gerações.


A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é movida pelo crescimento: crescemos nosso negócio, impulsionamos o crescimento dos negócios dos nossos clientes e desenvolvemos a carreira das nossas pessoas. O crescimento começa com o empoderamento. Por isso, damos aos nossos colaboradores a liberdade para agir como empreendedores inovadores e responsáveis, motivados e preparados para oferecer aos nossos consumidores produtos excepcionais e momentos inesquecíveis — e se divertir ao longo dessa jornada.


Sobre a Função

Seu propósito será impulsionar a presença, o abastecimento e a visibilidade de Kibon no ponto de venda, executando o roteiro definido e assegurando os padrões de execução, para gerar crescimento sustentável da carteira e experiência de compra diferenciada.


Responsabilidades

  • Vendedor de Sorvetes é responsável por execução operacional e presença de Kibon nos PDVs da rota, com média de 20 visitas/dia, garantindo abastecimento, visibilidade, layout e precificação, excelência em Loja Brilhante, registro no Sistema de Vendas e estímulo ao pedido via Digital.
  • Roteiro & Produtividade: visitar em média 20 clientes por dia com disciplina e pontualidade, garantindo cobertura integral da carteira e continuidade dos atendimentos;
  • Execução de Loja: assegurar abastecimento, layout, precificação e materiais de visibilidade conforme guia de execução;
    realizar limpeza e conservação dos equipamentos;
    remover produtos estranho / danificados e / ou produtos que não sejam Kibon e que estejam presentes nos equipamentos.
  • Carteira: atua sob orientação e com responsabilidade direta pelos resultados da carteira.
  • Loja Brilhante: realizar a pesquisa de Loja Brilhante com evidências (fotos) e registrar a execução no aplicativo corporativo.
  • Sistemas & Dados: abrir/fechar visitas, registrar pedidos, ocorrências e evidências no sistema de vendas;
    utilizar os insights devendas para priorização e melhoria de execução.
  • Pontos Quentes: negociar o melhor posicionamento dos equipamentos (pontos quentes) para maximizar visibilidade e giro.
  • Omnicanalidade do Pedido: orientar e influenciar o cliente a comprar via digital, quando aplicável, aumentando frequência e recorrência de pedidos.
  • Suporte Técnico: abrir e acompanhar chamados técnicos quando necessário em caso de quebra de equipamento, registrando aprovações/laudos conforme processo vigente.
  • Ativação & Desativação: negociar recolha/desativação de equipamentos, conforme diretrizes comerciais.
  • Prospecção: prospectar novos clientes na área de atuação, visando preenchimento e expansão de cobertura da rota.


Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Desejável superior (incompleto) em andamento.
  • Vivência com vendas e execução de rotina comercial.
  • Facilidade com tecnologia (celular, apps de pedido, sistemas de vendas, excel básico, entre outros).
  • CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.


Por que se juntar a nós?

Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:


  • Somos totalmente focados em crescimento.
  • Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade.
  • Vencemos juntos, com diversão.
  • Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria.
  • Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente.
  • Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.

Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível!


Você se encaixará aqui se valorizar uma cultura inclusiva e estiver entusiasmado(a) em aprender continuamente e desafiar a forma como trabalhamos, utilizando recursos digitais, dados e novas ideias para nos impulsionar cada vez mais.


Oferecemos

  • Cargos com verdadeira responsabilidade e impacto visível.
  • Liberdade para agir com rapidez, experimentar e desafiar a forma como as coisas são feitas.
  • Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce.
  • Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.


VOCÊ ESTÁ PRONTO(A) PARA CONSTRUIR O FUTURO DOS SORVETES?

Inscreva-se online e não se esqueça de enviar seu currículo. Sua candidatura será analisada de acordo com os requisitos da vaga, e entraremos em contato após o encerramento do processo para informar o status da sua inscrição.


Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência e precisar de apoio em qualquer etapa do nosso processo de recrutamento, entre em contato com o seu Talent Acquisition Partner.


Empregador que promove a igualdade de oportunidades


A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é uma empresa comprometida com a igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para contratação independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, origem nacional ou qualquer outra condição protegida pela legislação aplicável. Não toleramos qualquer forma de discriminação, inclusive com base em deficiência.

title: Remote Litigation Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's dispute resolution work in Brazil: commercial contract disputes, shareholder and post-M&A disputes, technology and IP disputes, debt recovery, and arbitration.
  • Lead case strategy, pleadings, evidence, and procedural steps for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies.
  • Advise clients on litigation risk before disputes arise — contract audits, escalation strategy, settlement positioning, and dispute resolution clauses.
  • Draft and negotiate letters before action, settlement agreements, and standstill and tolling arrangements;
    represent clients in mediation, arbitration, and court proceedings where licensed to do so.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising commercial litigation or arbitration in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with contract disputes — breach, termination, damages, limitation of liability, and injunctive relief.
  • Advocacy and procedure. Confident managing proceedings end-to-end, with rights of audience or substantial arbitration experience (ICC, LCIA, or local institutions).
  • Strong drafting under pressure. Pleadings, witness statements, and settlement terms that hold up.
  • Commercial judgment. You know when to fight, when to settle, and how to explain the difference to a client.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Bring modern tooling to dispute work — faster case preparation, sharper strategy, and clients who value clarity over billable churn.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Analista De Dho Pleno
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Analista de DHO Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de People e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, estruturar e executar programas de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento e eventos corporativos;
  • Realizar o levantamento de necessidades de treinamento e desenvolvimento junto às lideranças e áreas internas, identificando gaps e oportunidades;
  • Desenvolver, aplicar e acompanhar ações de educação corporativa, onboarding e desenvolvimento de colaboradores;
  • Elaborar conteúdos, materiais de apoio e experiências de aprendizagem alinhados às necessidades da organização;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de treinamento e desenvolvimento, incluindo adesão, avaliações de reação, eficácia e demais métricas da área, propondo melhorias a partir dos resultados;
  • Atuar em parceria com lideranças e BPs na identificação de necessidades de desenvolvimento de pessoas e times, propondo ações e soluções adequadas a cada contexto;
  • Apoiar os processos de desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de colaboradores, incluindo feedbacks, PDIs e ciclos de desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar a condução e o acompanhamento dos processos de avaliação de desempenho, garantindo organização das etapas e suporte às lideranças e colaboradores;
  • Atuar no acompanhamento das iniciativas de Clima, Cultura e Engajamento, apoiando a execução de pesquisas, análise de resultados e acompanhamento dos planos de ação;
  • Transformar resultados de pesquisas e outros dados de pessoas em insights e recomendações para apoiar a evolução do clima, da cultura e do engajamento;
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar campanhas de engajamento, comunicação interna e iniciativas relacionadas à Cultura;
  • Acompanhar rituais de reconhecimento e iniciativas de reforço dos valores e comportamentos esperados pela organização;
  • Apoiar a jornada do colaborador, contribuindo para uma experiência positiva e consistente nos diferentes momentos do ciclo;
  • Apoiar projetosde Desenvolvimento Humano e Organizacional, contribuindo para iniciativas de desenvolvimento, engajamento e experiência do colaborador;
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de DHO, utilizando dados para avaliar a efetividade das iniciativas e identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Conduzir entregas e projetos de média complexidade com autonomia, alinhando prioridades, prazos, escopo e stakeholders;
  • Antecipar riscos e impedimentos, propondo alternativas e soluções para garantir a qualidade e o cumprimento das entregas;
  • Contribuir paraa melhoria contínua dos processos, ferramentas e práticas de DHO;
  • Apoiar a atualização de organogramas e estruturas organizacionais;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as demais frentes de People, contribuindo para projetos e iniciativas conforme as necessidades e prioridades do negócio.


Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em Psicologia, Administração, Gestão de Recursos Humanos, Pedagogia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência profissional em Recursos Humanos, com atuação em DHO, Treinamento & Desenvolvimento ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência na estruturação e condução de iniciativas de Treinamento & Desenvolvimento, desde o levantamento de necessidades até o acompanhamento dos resultados;
  • Vivência com iniciativas de Clima, Cultura, Engajamento e Desenvolvimento de Pessoas;
  • Experiência no acompanhamento e análise de indicadores de pessoas, com capacidade de identificar tendências, oportunidades e propor ações a partir dos dados;
  • Boa comunicaçãoverbal e escrita, com facilidade para conduzir interações e construir relacionamento com diferentes públicos;
  • Organização, autonomia e capacidade de priorização, com habilidade para conduzir múltiplas demandas e projetos simultaneamente;
  • Perfil colaborativo e facilidade para atuar em parceria com lideranças, BPs e diferentes áreas da organização;
  • Conhecimento emferramentas Google e experiência com ferramentas corporativas, como Canva, Jira e Slack.


Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação em Educação Corporativa, Gestão de Pessoas, Desenvolvimento Organizacional ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprocessos de avaliação de desempenho, feedback e construção de PDIs;
  • Conhecimento emPeople Analytics e utilização de dados para apoiar decisões de desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Experiência comferramentas e sistemas de DHO, como plataformas de treinamento, clima, avaliação de desempenho e desenvolvimento de pessoas (ex.: Qulture.Rocks, Feedz, Sólides, Pulses, entre outras);
  • Conhecimento emmetodologias de educação corporativa, como 6Ds e Kirkpatrick;
  • Conhecimento emmetodologias de definição e acompanhamento de objetivos, como OKRs;
  • Formação ou certificação em ferramentas de análise de perfis comportamentais, como DISC, PDA ou MBTI;
  • Experiência comferramentas de assessment e desenvolvimento de lideranças.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

  • 🧾Modelo de contratação: PJ;
  • Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto: uma oportunidade de crescimento acessível para talentos em todo o Brasil;
  • ⚕ Plano de Saúde: mantenha-se saudável com nosso abrangente plano de saúde nacional com consultas online e presenciais;
  • ♀️GymPass/Wellhub: bem-estar completo para você cuidar da sua saúde física e mental com os aplicativos integrados;
  • Voucher Kit Escritório: receba um voucher para turbinar o seu espaço de trabalho e garantir seu conforto, comodidade e produtividade;
  • Férias remuneradas: desfrute de 30 dias de férias remuneradas por ano para recarregar suas energias e relaxar;
  • Programa Super-Get-Super: indique um talento e receba um bônus;
  • 😊Cultura colaborativa: nossa cultura é baseada na confiança, parceria e foco em resultados. Oferecemos um ambiente com autonomia e transparência;
  • Incentivo ao desenvolvimento: estamos comprometidos com a excelência e o aprendizado contínuo. Oferecemos avaliações semestrais, conversas de one-on-one, feedbacks construtivos, e muito mais;
  • Programa de Stock Option: possibilidade de se tornar sócio da empresa e participar diretamente do nosso crescimento. Somos reconhecidos como uma das startups mais promissoras do Brasil pela lista 100 Startups to Watch.



E aí, vamos juntos nesse SuperFoguete? 🚀

title: Senior Aws Cloud Infrastructure & Linux Engineer | Inglês Avançado
description:

Buscamos talento Senior AWS Cloud Infrastructure & Linux Engineer para atuar em um projeto estratégico de transformação e modernização de ambientes cloud corporativos. A posição exige forte experiência em AWS, Linux, automação de infraestrutura e operações em ambientes críticos de missão.

✅ Atuação 100% remota

✅ Projeto com duração inicial de 1 ano, com possibilidade de extensão

✅ Inglês avançado/fluente mandatório


Requisitos

  • Sólida experiência com arquitetura e operações em ambientes AWS
  • Administração avançada de Linux (RHEL, Oracle Linux e Ubuntu)
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform e/ou CloudFormation)
  • Automação com Shell Script e Python
  • Docker e Kubernetes (EKS é diferencial)
  • CI/CD e práticas DevOps
  • AWS IAM, segurança, governança e observabilidade

Diferenciais

Se você gosta de desafios envolvendo Cloud Infrastructure, Linux, Automação e DevOps em escala corporativa , essa pode ser uma excelente oportunidade para dar o próximo passo na sua carreira.

PLR;

Vale alimentação;

Presente de aniversário;

Muito mais.

description:
About Revolut

About the role

Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.


We’re looking for a Financial Crime Analyst to identify suspicious activity and ensure we’re treating customers fairly. You’ll be investigating internal SARs and complex cases by applying judgement, analytical skills, and solid decision-making to identify where grounds for suspicion of money laundering exist.


To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.



What you'll be doing

  • Reviewing, investigating, and reporting financial crime cases
  • Providing ongoing monitoring and resolving formal complaints and Financial Ombudsman Service complaints
  • Dealing appropriately with consent refusals following SAR submissions
  • Acting as a point of contact for law enforcement agencies in ongoing criminal investigations that commenced from a submitted SAR
  • Acting in accordance with written policies, procedures, and relevant legislation
  • Cooperating with other teams by providing professional and efficient front-line compliance support, seeking to improve company processes



What you'll need

  • A bachelor's degree (must be able to provide a certificate)
  • 3+ years in financial crime investigations, or 1+ years of SAR reporting experience
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)
  • Experience working in a regulated or policy-driven environment (e.G., financial institutions, law enforcement)
  • Experience with investigative methodologies, evidenced by the use of analytical tools (e.G., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts)
  • The ability to work with multiple stakeholders and take ownership of assigned workload
  • Adaptability and experience with fast-cycle feedback
  • To be able to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends



Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • A degree in law or a STEM subject
  • A professional certification (e.G., ICA or ACAMS)
  • Familiarity with jurisdiction-specific financial regulations
  • Experience in crypto or blockchain analysis



Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday.


We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

title: Remote Investment Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side.
  • Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion.
  • Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents.
  • Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits.
  • Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds.
  • Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast;
    your documents still close cleanly.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly;
co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz;
Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

title: Technical Sales Engineer
description:
We are looking for a customer-focused Technical Sales Engineer to join Quortex.


In this role, you will collaborate closely with Sales teams and customers to understand business challenges, design technical solutions, and demonstrate the value of Quortex technologies. You will act as a trusted advisor throughout the sales process, helping customers evaluate architectural options and achieve their business objectives.


This position combines technical expertise, customer engagement, solution design, and business consulting. You will work with telecommunications operators, broadcasters, media companies, streaming providers, and technology partners to design innovative video delivery and streaming solutions.


Professional proficiency in English is required. Portuguese and Spanish language skills are highly desirable to support customer engagement and business growth across the region.


What you’ll do


Customer Engagement and Solution Consulting


  • Act as a technical advisor and subject matter expert for customers and partners.
  • Partner with Sales teams to develop customer strategies and solution approaches.
  • Understand customer business and technical requirements and translate them into tailored solutions.
  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders, from technical teams to executive decision-makers.
  • Communicate the business value, expected return on investment, and strategic benefits of proposed solutions.
  • Conduct technical discovery sessions and architecture workshops.


Solution Design and Technical Leadership


  • Design and present solution architectures across the Quortex portfolio, including SaaS, public cloud, private cloud, hybrid, and on-premises offerings.
  • Recommend scalable, reliable, and cost-effective architectures aligned with customer objectives.
  • Design solutions covering end-to-end video processing, delivery, monitoring, and distribution workflows.
  • Advise customers on cloud video workflows, scalability, content delivery, recording, and monitoring.
  • Translate customer requirements and market feedback into recommendations that can contribute to product roadmaps.
  • Support customers with architectural decisions and video workflow migration to the cloud.


Pre-Sales Support


  • Deliver product demonstrations, technical presentations, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Lead and support Proof of Concept activities, translating customer needs into clear technical use cases and success criteria.
  • Participate in RFP and RFI processes.
  • Prepare technical proposals and responses to customer requirements.
  • Create solution documentation, architecture diagrams, and supporting technical materials.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues related to Linux, networking, video systems, and system integrations during demonstrations and Proofs of Concept.


Business Development and Market Engagement


  • Contribute to territory planning and account strategies.
  • Support lead-generation activities through customer engagement, webinars, presentations, events, and technical content.
  • Collaborate with partners, resellers, systems integrators, and other ecosystem stakeholders to develop joint opportunities.
  • Represent Quortex at industry conferences, trade shows, and customer events when required.
  • Participate as an exhibitor or speaker at relevant industry events, depending on experience and business needs.


Internal Collaboration


  • Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales teams.
  • Provide customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights to support product development.
  • Help connect customer needs with product capabilities and future roadmap opportunities.
  • Share technical knowledge and best practices across the organization.


What we’re looking for


Mandatory Technical Experience


  • Knowledge of end-to-end video workflows, including:

Ingest

Encoding and transcoding

Statistical multiplexing, or statmux

Adaptive Bitrate Streaming, or ABR

Over-the-Top delivery, or OTT

Direct-to-Home distribution, or DTH

Primary distribution

Cable distribution

  • Experience troubleshooting Linux environments, networking, and system integrations.
  • Knowledge of public and private cloud architectures applied to video workflows.
  • Experience designing or deploying cloud-based video solutions.
  • Ability to conduct Proofs of Concept, from understanding customer requirements to defining the proposed solution and success criteria.
  • Ability to translate customer needs and technical feedback into product and roadmap recommendations.
  • Experience participating in RFP or RFI processes and preparing technical proposals.
  • Understanding of video processing, packaging, compression, content delivery, and streaming technologies.
  • Experience with live and on-demand video architectures.
  • Ability to design and explain technical solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Desirable Technical Experience


  • Knowledge of advertising technologies and video monetization models.
  • Experience with Server-Side Ad Insertion, or SSAI.
  • Familiarity with Server-Guided Ad Insertion, or SGAI, and Dynamic Ad Insertion, or DAI.
  • Experience with hybrid environments and the migration of video workflows to the cloud.
  • Knowledge of broadcast and media standards, including:

SMPTE ST 2110

SCTE-35

SCTE-224

  • Experience with Content Delivery Networks.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes.
  • Experience with video compression, packaging, encoding, DRM, and content delivery.
  • Understanding of cloud-based media workflows and recording solutions.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and cloud-native architectures.


Business and Customer Skills


  • Ability to understand customer challenges and translate them into practical technical solutions.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience discussing both technical requirements and business outcomes with customers.
  • Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and project coordination skills.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of SaaS business models.
  • A customer-focused approach supported by strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.
  • Experience working with partners, resellers, systems integrators, or other ecosystem stakeholders is advantageous.


Differentiators


The following experience is not required but would be considered an advantage:


  • Participation in large-scale projects as a Solutions Architect or in a similar technical leadership role.
  • Programming or scripting skills.
  • Experience representing an organization at trade shows as an exhibitor, speaker, or technical presenter.
  • Cloud architecture certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or another recognized provider.
  • Additional training or certifications in video technologies, broadcast engineering, networking, or cloud architecture.


Preferred Background


We welcome candidates from a range of sectors, including:

  • Media and Entertainment
  • Streaming Platforms
  • Telecommunications
  • Cloud and SaaS Companies
  • Video Technology Vendors
  • Systems Integration and Consulting

title: Analytics And Automation Specialist
description:
REMOTE ANALYTICS AND AUTOMATION SPECIALIST TO WORK WITH SYDNEY, AUSTRALIA AGENCY.


About The Role


SOMO is a Sydney-based performance marketing and digital agency, with a small London presence, hiring a Digital Analytics & Automation Specialist to help deliver on a services agreement with a major client, spanning analytics administration, technical implementation, measurement strategy, and workflow automation. This is a hands-on role covering everyday system hygiene through to building automated processes that reduce manual reporting and operational overhead.


The role is structured around three core service pillars, plus a growing automation function.


Working Hours & Availability


This role reports into a Sydney-based team, so overlap with Sydney business hours is essential :


  • Core availability window (required): 9:00am–1:00pm Sydney time (AEST/AEDT), every working day
  • The remaining hours of your 8-hour day are flexible and can be worked to suit your own schedule/timezone
  • Given Brazil's timezone difference, this core window will typically fall in the evening to midnight for a Brazil-based hire, candidates should confirm this is workable for them before applying


Key Responsibilities


1. Admin Tasks (system hygiene & operational support)

Manage platform access (GA4, GTM, Looker Studio)

Update dashboard permissions

Set up and maintain scheduled reports/emails

Conduct system hygiene audits

Maintain progress tracking documentation

Acknowledge and resolve routine requests within same-day/1-business-day turnaround


2. Implementation Tasks (technical setup & troubleshooting)

Configure event tracking (form submissions, button clicks, etc.)

Build and maintain dashboards, with a strong emphasis on advanced Looker Studio usage and setup (GA4 also used)

Pull data from third-party platforms via APIs and manage API integrations

Perform ad hoc data extractions

Troubleshoot data discrepancies across platforms

Support integrations with other third-party systems as needed


3. Strategy Tasks (consultative & planning support)

Contribute to measurement framework design

Assist with attribution model development

Support privacy/compliance strategy work (e.G. cookie consent changes)

Help plan reporting infrastructure

Assist in journey mapping and insights workshops


4. AI Automation (new capability)

Design and build AI-powered automation flows to streamline reporting, data extraction, and routine admin tasks (e.G. using tools like Zapier, Make, n8n, or custom scripts)

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive workflows currently done manually across admin and implementation tasks

Build and maintain automations that pull from analytics platforms (GA4, GTM, Looker Studio) and push into reporting or notification systems

Document automation logic clearly so workflows are maintainable by others on the team


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advanced Looker Studio usage and setup
  • Experience with event tracking implementation and debugging data discrepancies
  • Comfort pulling data from third-party platforms via APIs , and general familiarity working with API endpoints
  • Understanding of measurement frameworks and attribution modelling
  • Working knowledge of privacy/compliance requirements affecting tracking (e.G. cookie consent)
  • Demonstrated experience building AI automation flows — e.G. Zapier, Make.Com, n8n, or custom integrations using LLM/API-based tooling
  • Strong documentation habits
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while flagging proactive recommendations
  • Excellent English (written and verbal) — essential
  • Comfortable communicating directly with clients , including handling complex briefs and translating technical detail into clear, client-ready language


Nice to Have

  • Experience managing Google Ads campaigns and reporting on channel performance
  • Prior agency-side experience managing enterprise client relationships
  • Exposure to Python or JavaScript for custom automation/scripting


Working Arrangements

  • Must be available Sydney 9:00am–1:00pm (AEST/AEDT) daily for overlap with the Sydney team;
    remaining hours of the 8-hour day are flexible.
  • Standard client-facing hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00am–1:00pm AEST, excluding public holidays, unless otherwise agreed.
  • Tasks are formally assigned with defined scope and timelines.
  • Deliverables must meet a professional standard and align with the task categories above.
  • Four weeks annual leave, sick leave + 9 days of public holidays. These can be used for your local public holidays if you wish
  • Competitive salary in USD.


Things You Should Know About SOMO

  • We are a Paid Media Performance agency. Our clients cover a broad spectrum of industries.
  • Our team is spread across AU, UK, Brazil and Argentina. Everyone is treated the same, same workers rights and benefits. With this comes the same expectation of professionalism and accountability, irrespective of the location
  • We’re very proud of our staff retention rate, our first South American Talent hired 4 years ago has grown to be an integral, senior member of the team
  • Continuous learning and improvement is a pillar of our business. We have time set aside every week for internal training and coming together as an agency to discuss

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:
About iQIYI

iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.


Role purpose

Support iQIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.


Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions;
    final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.



Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.
  • Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.
  • Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets;
    familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.


Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms.
  • Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America.
  • Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams.
  • Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models.
  • Mandarin Chinese.
  • Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.


Employment conditions and benefits

  • Permanent CLT employment agreement.
  • Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law.
  • Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance.
  • Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance.
  • 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law.
  • Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager


Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C (exclusive membership services), B2B (corporate travel management), and B2B2C (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our bTd Corp Tool .

This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to bTd travel benefits and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.


CX Travel Specialist (2 positions: Either Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time or From 4 PM to 1 AM Brazil time)

We are looking for two (2) CX Travel Specialist to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidates are experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.


Main Responsibilities

- Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.

- Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.

- Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.

- Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.

- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.


Requirements

- Experience in luxury or corporate travel.

- Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)

- Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.

- Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.

- Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a "learning by doing" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

- Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus


Why Join Us

- Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.

- Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.

- Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

- Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements


bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.


Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) .
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.


Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.


Important Note Before Applying:

Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications and can prove it with your LinkedIn profile or updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just "gets it" — we need a self-starter ready to deliver results from day one .

Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms;
we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note: Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone! 🚀


bTd Travel – Where Business Meets Innovation.

title: Finance Manager
description:
When you join GAR, you join something bigger. Big in scale, big in opportunities to grow, and big in impact. With over 100,000 employees across 14 countries, spanning Asia, Europe, North America, and South America, Golden Agri-Resources (GAR) is one of the largest agribusinesses in the world. We manage over half a million hectares of palm oil plantations, including smallholder farms, across Indonesia. But our size is only part of the story. Since 1997, we’ve put sustainability at the centre of how we grow, working hand-in-hand with farmers, communities, and partners to deliver food, fuel, and a better future.

We’re a seed-to-shelf business rooted in palm oil, now expanding across other essential crops like sugar, soybean, sunflower, and coconut.

Our people are our edge. We invest in them through global opportunities, cross-border exposure, and continuous learning, because growing a better business starts with growing our people.

Here, your career feeds something meaningful for the planet, people, and generations to come


We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to join our team in São Paulo, Brazil. In this role, you will oversee all aspects of finance, accounting, tax, legal, IT, and treasury, including financial reporting, budgeting, taxation, cash management, and statutory compliance. You will be responsible for maintaining the full set of ledgers and accounts, managing monthly closing activities, preparing financial and statutory reports, ensuring compliance with applicable local, international, and internal accounting and tax standards, and supporting the timely and accurate consolidation of financial information for Head Office. As a business partner, you will provide data-driven insights to support decision-making and play a key role in building systems, processes, and frameworks from scratch, particularly across finance, tax, legal, and treasury. This is a highly hands-on role, especially during the initial phase, requiring you to personally execute and/or review key finance processes such as payments, bank reconciliations, tax calculations, invoicing, accounting entries, and month-end closing. The ideal candidate will also have the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams while working effectively in a dynamic and growing environment.

  • Maintain all accounting records in the ERP system to ensure accuracy of the general ledger and financial accounts.

  • Review and analyse financial statements/records and provide reports and data analysis to various internal stakeholders.
  • Manage day-to-day risk exposures, -reports and -mitigation measures such as insurances, hedges etc. Work with credit team to manage counterpart exposures and follow up on overdue receivables.

  • Lead the transition of the bookkeeping from external service providers to "in-house".
  • Ensure desired IT platform and relevant key procedures will be implemented.
  • Coordinate and assist finance department in Brazil with the financial record keeping of the activities undertaken in Brazil.
  • Oversee local administrative matters and purchase office supplies and equipment while maintaining appropriate stock levels in a cost-efficient manner.
  • Manage and execute all payments and customer invoicing, including entering payment instructions into the online banking system and coordinating the required approvals to ensure payments are released accurately and within the established deadlines.
  • Prepare and process cash claims and expense reimbursements for the Brazilian team.
  • Advise and assist various departments on accounting, tax and legal compliance by researching and ensuring compliance to applicable internal, national and international rules and regulations.
  • Coordinate external / internal audits and prepare audit requirements.
  • Liaise with central teams in Singapore / Jakarta for ad-hoc queries and analysis requests.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for office managers, IT teams, auditors, accountants, finance managers, and HR teams across other locations in the EU and Americas regions.
  • Act as the first point of contact for external stakeholders such as banks, legal, tax authorities and other regulatory bodies, service providers.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 8+ years’ relevant experience in accounting, finance and trade control
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian and international accounting, tax and regulatory requirements.
  • Working experience in the Commodity industry
  • Experience with tax, legal, banking
  • Experience with implementing IT systems and consolidation work
  • Proficient with MS Office
  • Experience with ERP software (SAP is an advantage)
  • Experience working in an international environment
  • Experience building & leading a high performing team
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
  • Fluent in Spanish, both written and spoken is preferred

We Offer

title: Overseas Pre-Sales Engineer-Brazil
description:
Responsibility：

Solution Development and Customization：

  • Communicate deeply with customers (commercial enterprises, industrial customers, agricultural cooperatives or government agencies) to evaluate their energy needs (such as cost reduction, renewable energy integration or grid stability).
  • Work with internal technical teams to design and propose customized solutions, such as 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems, battery backup (BESS) or hybrid energy projects.
  • Integrate photovoltaic, energy storage or other technologies according to the customer's specific application scenarios (such as peak shaving, off-grid power supply or frequency regulation services) to ensure the absorption and competitiveness of the solution.

Sales and Business Development：

  • Develop and implement solutions sales strategies to achieve company revenue targets, especially in the fast-growing distributed PV and energy storage market in Brazil.
  • Identify potential customers and sales opportunities, and proactively promote company products and services, such as solutions for the southeast region with high electricity prices or the northeast region with abundant solar resources.
  • Convert potential customers into actual orders by demonstrating technical advantages and return on investment (ROI).

Bridging technology and business

  • Explain the technical details of the solution to customers (such as PV system efficiency, energy storage discharge time) and translate them into business language (cost savings, revenue improvement).
  • Prepare and present professional sales proposals, including technical specifications, financial models (such as payback period calculation) and project benefit analysis.
  • Submit high-quality proposals on behalf of the company and participate in negotiations in bidding or competition (such as the 2025 energy storage auction).

Customer Relationship and After-Sales Support

  • Serve as the customer's primary contact to ensure smooth progress from solution design to project delivery, and provide technical consultation and support.
  • Follow up the progress of project implementation, coordinate with the engineering team, and solve problems that arise during installation or operation.
  • Provide after-sales service suggestions (such as system upgrades, maintenance plans) to promote long-term cooperation and upsell.

Market Analysis and Product Feedback

  • Monitor Brazilian energy market trends, such as policy changes (Law 14.300, ANEEL Energy Storage Specifications), competitor dynamics, and customer demand changes.
  • Collect customer feedback and work with product development teams to optimize solutions (such as increasing storage capacity or reducing costs).
  • Report market insights to management regularly and recommend new product or service directions.

Cross-departmental collaboration

  • Work closely with the technical team to ensure that the solution complies with Brazilian grid standards (such as ONS requirements) and customer expectations.
  • Coordinate with the finance department to provide financing options (such as BNDES loans or installments) to help customers overcome financial barriers.
  • Liaise with procurement and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery of equipment (such as PV modules, batteries).

Training and knowledge sharing

  • Provide technical training to sales teams or customers to explain the working principles and advantages of photovoltaic and energy storage systems.
  • Participate in industry events (such as energy exhibitions) to showcase company solutions and build brand influence.


Requirement：

Preferred:

  • Direct experience in the field of photovoltaics or energy storage, such as selling 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems or battery energy storage solutions.
  • Participation in project development in the Brazilian market, such as distributed generation or grid integration projects.

title: Pessoa Estagiária De Engenharia - Indicadores
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

title: Inside Sales Manager
description:
Kaspersky has been protecting individuals and corporate clients all over the world from cyber threats for 29 years.


We have 400 million unique users, 270 000 corporate clients, 517 products, 1100 technological patents and 34 offices around the world. Today our team has more than 5 500 top level experts, all of them regular people with their own talents and hobbies.


Together we protect the world from cyber threats.


Join us to become part of an exceptional team, while remaining yourself and using your skills to keep us growing and evolving.


Kaspersky is looking for an Inside Sales Manager to drive SMB sales growth in Brazil by developing relationships with customers and channel partners and identifying new business opportunities. This role is responsible for managing sales pipelines, supporting partners throughout the sales cycle, positioning Kaspersky solutions and value proposition, and helping to win deals against the competition.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Consistently meet or exceed sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory;
  • Drive SMB salesthrough channel partners, including new business, renewals, upsell and cross-sell opportunities;
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with partners and SMB customers;
  • Identify, assess and develop new business opportunities and prospective customers;
  • Manage and progress sales pipelines, ensuring accurate forecasting and execution against business goals;
  • Promote and clearly articulate Kaspersky’s value proposition and competitive advantages to partners and customers;
  • Recruit, train and enable partners to effectively position and sell Kaspersky solutions;
  • Balance farmingand hunting activities by developing existing accounts while acquiring new customers;
  • Conduct regularfollow-ups and coordinate with partners to support deal progression and increase win rates;
  • Work closely with Sales, Channel and Marketing teams on joint sales and marketing activities;
  • Support webinars, events, product demonstrations and other activities aimed at generating demand and business opportunities;
  • Maintain accurate documentation of sales activities, partner engagements and opportunities.


Required Experience, Skills and Competencies:


  • 5–8 years of experience in Sales, Account Management or Business Development within the technology industry;
  • Strong understanding of the full sales cycle and experience managing sales pipelines and business opportunities;
  • Experience selling technology solutions, services or complex projects based on customer needs and business value;
  • Experience in both new business development and existing account management;
  • Experience working with customers and channel partners;
  • Strong sales and business development skills with a focus on achieving revenue targets;
  • Strong communication, relationship management and stakeholder management skills;
  • Ability to clearly articulate and position a value proposition to customers and partners;
  • Strong teamworkand cross-functional collaboration skills;
  • Problem-solvingand conflict-resolution skills;
  • Result-orientedmindset;
  • Fluent English.

Você é ousado, criativo e não tem medo de desafios? A Embracon quer te conhecer!


Buscamos pessoas inquietas, que confiam em seu potencial e compartilham da mesma paixão que todos nós: transformar a vida de nossos clientes.

Dar suporte à gestão na administração de pessoas, no entendimento das burocracias que envolvem a filial e o negócio.

Somos a Embracon


Há mais de 30 anos, atuamos no mercado de consórcio, trazendo as melhores soluções para que as pessoas possam realizar seus sonhos, sejam eles quais forem. Para isso, nos baseamos naquilo que mais acreditamos: nossos valores.


Ser Simples, Inovar Sempre, Construir Juntos e Ser Íntegro são a fórmula do nosso sucesso. Afinal, é por meio desses valores que garantimos a parceria com nossos mais de 175 mil clientes ativos e também que mantemos nossos 3 mil colaboradores e mais de 800 parceiros de vendas engajados ao nosso propósito.


Se hoje somos considerados uma das maiores administradoras de consórcio do país (segundo o ranking do Branco Central) e avaliados, há mais de 10 anos (pelo GPTW), como umas das melhores empresas do Brasil para trabalhar, é porque contamos com um time que confia naquilo que fazemos e transforma os sonhos de nossos clientes em seus próprios objetivos.

Gerar encantamento.


VISÃO

Ser a maior, melhor e mais confiável administradora de consórcio do país.

Ser Simples – Acreditamos no poder da simplicidade. Ela conecta e transforma desafios em oportunidades, impulsionando o crescimento do jeito que queremos: sempre juntos!


Ser Íntegro – Integridade e respeito são nossa base. São eles que sustentam a relação de confiança, ética e transparência que cultivamos com todas as pessoas.


Inovar Sempre – Inovar é atitude de protagonista. É provocar novas formas de fazer, independentemente de sua área.


Construir Juntos – Fazer juntos é o melhor jeito para evoluir! É quebrar qualquer tipo de barreira e cultivar a cooperação e o genuíno espírito de equipe.


PROPÓSITO

Realizar sonhos

Aqui, cada um tem a oportunidade de trilhar a sua própria carreira, se desenvolver, trazer novas ideias e soluções. Para isso, oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho onde prevalece o cuidado, a proximidade, o acolhimento, a confiança e as relações genuínas.

title: 3d Character Animator
description:
3D Character Animator - Indie Platform Fighter

I'm looking to hire an experienced 3D Character Animator to help bring the fighters in an upcoming indie platform fighter to life.

The game is a fast-paced, combat-focused platform fighter featuring gods, deities, and religious figures from different traditions battling one another. I'm looking for someone who can create dynamic, highly readable, hard-hitting combat animation , with attacks that feel powerful, responsive, expressive, and satisfying in gameplay.

What I'm Looking For

Required

  • Strong professional portfolio demonstrating 3D character animation
  • Ideally 5–10+ years of 3D animation experience
  • Experience working on indie games or other real-time game projects
  • Excellent understanding of:
  • Combat animation
  • Body mechanics
  • Weight and momentum
  • Timing, anticipation, follow-through, and impact
  • Exaggerated poses and readable silhouettes
  • Ability to create everything from quick jabs and movement animations to large, epic special attacks and finishing moves
  • Understanding of the technical constraints of animation for real-time gameplay
  • Comfortable iterating based on how animations actually feel in-game

Strongly Preferred

  • Cascadeur
  • Blender
  • Unity
  • Experience exporting animation assets and implementing/testing them inside Unity
Bonus Skills

I'd especially love to find someone capable of handling more of the full 3D character pipeline , including:

  • Retopology (for minor clean-up work)
  • UV unwrapping
  • Texturing
  • Rigging (especially for animals, or characters with multiple arms or wings)
  • Weight painting
  • Character and animal animation
  • Preparing/exporting characters and animations for Unity
  • Troubleshooting rigs, meshes, animation clips, and import settings

These additional skills are a major plus, but animation is the priority . If you're an exceptional combat animator who specializes specifically in animation, I still want to hear from you.

The Project

This is an indie platform fighter built around a roster of mythological and religious characters, with an intentionally comedic, irreverent, and satirical tone.

Important: The game contains deliberately blasphemous and sacrilegious humor and jokes about gods, religions, religious beliefs, and religious figures. Applicants need to be genuinely comfortable working on that kind of material.

Who Would Be a Great Fit

I'm looking for someone who:

  • Loves making combat animation feel ridiculously satisfying
  • Understands that gameplay readability matters as much as beautiful animation
  • Can exaggerate movement without making it feel weightless
  • Is comfortable working collaboratively and iterating quickly
  • Has experience with small or independent game-development teams
  • Can take a relatively simple stylized character and give them a huge amount of personality through movement
  • If you've worked on a fighting game, platform fighter, action game, or anything involving exaggerated character combat, I'd especially like to see it.

title: Analista Fp&A Júnior

Gostamos de proporcionar o bem aos outros, seja através da nossa comida, seja através da nossa forma de trabalhar.

Gostamos de gente que faz

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe ambição

Não temos limite pra crescer

title: Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern
description:
Primary Purpose of the Position

The Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern provides administrative, scheduling, and operational support to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager in the coordination and execution of events across Graded.

A primary responsibility is to support reservations and scheduling for Art Center spaces, including the Black Box Theatre, Haddad Center, Art Gallery, classrooms, and other designated areas. The Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern also assists with event records, calendar updates, service requests, purchase orders, payment processes, event preparation, and on-site logistical support.


Principle Duties and Responsibilities

Art Center Reservations & Scheduling

  • Support reservations and scheduling for Art Center spaces.
  • Review requests, check availability, identify scheduling conflicts, and maintain accurate reservation records.
  • Enter and update approved reservations in EvM and relevant school calendars.
  • Communicate confirmations, changes, and space-use information to requesters.
  • Follow up on missing information and escalate conflicts or exceptions to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.

Event Management System & Calendar Support

  • Provide administrative and logistical support for school events.
  • Assist with event schedules, checklists, service requests, guest information, signage, and other operational materials.
  • Coordinate routine requests with Maintenance, ICT, Cafeteria, Security, and other departments as needed.
  • Maintain organized event records, files, spreadsheets, and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with the creation of purchase orders in the ERP system, payment requests, and process follow-up.
  • Support faculty and staff with routine questions related to reservations and event procedures.

Event Coordination & Administrative Support

  • Assist with event setup and breakdown and help ensure spaces are ready for scheduled use.
  • Support guest reception, registration, wayfinding, and other event-day activities as needed.
  • Monitor assigned event spaces and report operational, maintenance, safety, or facility concerns.
  • Help ensure spaces are properly reset following events.
  • Support evening and weekend events when required and permitted within the internship schedule.
  • Assist with the creation of purchase orders in the ERP system, as well as with payment requests and follow-up throughout the process.

Art Center Space Readiness

  • Conduct routine checks of Art Center spaces in connection with scheduled reservations and events.
  • Help ensure that reserved spaces are organized and ready for use.
  • Identify and report concerns related to cleanliness, furniture, audiovisual equipment, maintenance, safety, or general facility conditions.
  • Support the organization of event supplies, signage, materials, and other shared resources.
  • Report discrepancies between approved reservations and actual space usage to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.
  • Assist in maintaining organized records related to Art Center space utilization and recurring operational needs.

Professional Practice

  • Work under the direction of the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager and collaborate professionally with different school departments.
  • Maintain confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries with students.
  • Comply with Graded’s Child Safeguarding Code of Conduct, policies, and procedures.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, reliability, organization, and a service-oriented approach.
  • Perform other internship-related duties as assigned by the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.


Certifications and Education

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree program eligible for a formal internship.


Experience

  • Previous internship, volunteer, university, or extracurricular experience involving events, administration, customer service, scheduling, or project support.
  • Familiarity with calendars, spreadsheets, reservation systems, or event management tools.

title: Supervisor De Contas A Receber
description:
About the Company

CMA CGM is one of the world’s leading transportation and logistics groups, operating across global markets and connecting businesses through integrated maritime, land, and air solutions. The Group is committed to innovation, operational excellence, sustainability, and the continuous development of its people and business.


Job Description

We are looking for an Accounts Receivable Supervisor to lead the company’s accounts receivable and collection activities, ensuring that revenues are accurately and timely collected while maintaining appropriate credit policies and terms.


This position plays a key role in improving cash flow, managing credit and collection processes, reducing financial and operational risks, and strengthening relationships with internal and external stakeholders.


Our opportunities are inclusive and open to professionals with disabilities (PwD).


Mission

The professional will be responsible for overseeing the Accounts Receivable function, ensuring effective credit management, collection performance, and cash flow optimization. The role will lead the team, monitor key performance indicators, identify risks and improvement opportunities, and ensure compliance with internal policies and Group procedures.


Main Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Define targets, provide the necessary resources, and manage team performance;
  • Develop and support team members to maximize individual and collective performance;
  • Ensure the teamhas the appropriate skills and profile for the area;
  • Oversee communication, instructions, and performance of outsourced collection partners;
  • Monitor productivity, quality, and target achievement across the team.


Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Develop and implement strategic objectives to improve cash flow and manage DSO;
  • Manage credit terms and ensure compliance with established policies and procedures;
  • Assess and approve credit within established authorization limits, supporting the CFO in credit assessments when required;
  • Manage collection activities performed by internal teams and outsourced collection companies;
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate financial and operational risks;
  • Ensure accuratereconciliation of accounts receivable balances in partnership with the Accounting team;
  • Maintain accurate records, reports, and performance information for key stakeholders;
  • Monitor KPIs and implement corrective actions whenever necessary;
  • Review and improve processes and procedures to enhance collection results and operational efficiency.


Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with Commercial and Invoicing teams to accelerate collections and strengthen customer relationships;
  • Partner with Finance, Customer Service, Legal, and Operations to resolve accounts receivable issues;
  • Support internal and external customers by negotiating solutions to outstanding issues;
  • Provide effective solutions to meet business requirements and customer needs;
  • Maintain stakeholders informed through accurate and controlled reports and information;
  • Act as a transversal business partner across different functions to improve cash flow and customer relationships.


Management Scope

  • Leadership of a large team of 7 employees;
  • Management of internal and outsourced collection activities;
  • Coordination ofprojects and initiatives related to credit and collections;
  • Interaction with senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities & Expected Results

The Accounts Receivable Supervisor will be expected to maintain strong performance against the organization’s KPIs, ensuring that accounts receivable remains under control and that collection targets are consistently achieved.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA is considered a plus;
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in credit authorization and accounts receivable/collection practices;
  • Previous experience in an Accounts Receivable leadership position;
  • Advanced Excel skills;
  • Knowledge of SAP is considered a plus;
  • Fluent English;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills;
  • Strong negotiation and problem-solving capabilities.


Key Competencies

Leadership | Financial Acumen | Results Orientation | Planning | Assertiveness | Teamwork | Negotiation | Problem Solving | Transversality | Conflict Management


Join Our Team!


Be part of a global organization where your expertise will contribute to improving cash flow, strengthening customer relationships, driving operational excellence, and supporting sustainable business growth.

description:
Venha fazer parte da Lindt Brasil!


O que buscamos!


Procuramos um(a) Especialista de Inovação (PMO) com forte capacidade de organização e articulação multifuncional para coordenar os projetos sazonais e permanentes do nosso portfólio.

Como Especialista de Inovação (PMO), você terá uma visão end-to-end da nossa estratégia de novos produtos, garantindo que o encantamento da marca chegue com excelência impecável ao consumidor:


  • Governança & Timelines: Liderar a gestão dos lançamentos sazonais (que representam cerca de 25% do NTS do ano) e permanentes, acompanhando cronogramas, antecipando riscos e garantindo o cumprimento dos marcos críticos;

  • Ownership de Fluxos-Chave: Garantir a prontidão (readiness ) das inovações, liderando o fluxo de desenvolvimento de artwork (via ESKO) e a governança de Product Master Data ;
  • Eficiência e Sustentabilidade: Monitorar preventivamente potenciais sobras de insumos para otimizar recursos, sugerindo ações estratégicas em conjunto com as áreas para evitar descartes;
  • Documentação & Melhoria Contínua: Estruturar relatórios e ferramentas de governança (NPR, NPA, product data sheets , post mortem ) e conduzir os fóruns de FUP Brasil e Chile com foco em aprendizados e decisões ágeis.


O que buscamos em você?


  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Comunicação, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos / PMO, inovação ou áreas correlatas (preferencialmente em empresas de bens de consumo / FMCG);

  • Perfil organizado, disciplinado, com forte capacidade de influência sem autoridade direta, excelente visão de processos, atenção aos detalhes e mente curiosa e colaborativa.


O que oferecemos


Em nossa empresa, valorizamos cada colaborador como um pilar essencial do nosso sucesso. Por isso, oferecemos benefícios únicos que cuidam de você e de sua família!


  • Benefícios de Alimentação: Com nosso VR e VA, você decide como e onde se alimentar, com qualidade e liberdade.

  • Seguro de Vida: Nosso seguro de vida garante proteção e segurança em qualquer momento da jornada.
  • Desconto nos Produtos Lindt: Desfrute dos nossos chocolates inigualáveis com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores.

title: Head Comercial (Oneflow)
